marks.q: The Company expects to deliver revenue of at least €7.8m in FY 2026, representing growth of at least 22% over the prior year, with Adjusted EBITDA of at least €0.5m.
Whilst the Company had its strongest ever first quarter in terms of new test order activity, it has historically, and continues to, encounter protracted timelines to convert pipeline opportunities.
Accordingly, the Board now expects the Company to generate revenues of circa €1.8m for FY26 (compared with previous guidance of €7.8m).
Given that Windar's technology is now proven across multiple platforms, the Board are optimistic that a number of these trials will result in orders in late 2026 and 2027.

These issues however, alongside longer than expected timelines to convert two large customer orders worth over €6m, mean the Group enters FY26 with a more cautious outlook, and we now expect revenues of circa €1.8m for the year.
Trading in H2 2026 remains in line with management expectations for the full year.
